def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    blocks=[(i,j) for i in range(h-1) for j in range(w-1)
            if g[i][j]==2 and g[i][j+1]==2 and g[i+1][j]==2 and g[i+1][j+1]==2]
    corners=set()
    for bi,bj in blocks:
        corners |= {(bi,bj),(bi,bj+1),(bi+1,bj),(bi+1,bj+1)}
    shadows=set()
    for ci,cj in corners:
        k=1
        while True:
            a,b=ci-k,cj-k
            if not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w) or g[a][b]==2 and (a,b) in corners: break
            if (a,b) in corners: break
            shadows.add((a,b)); k+=1
    moves=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v in (0,2): continue
            bi,bj=min(blocks,key=lambda b:abs(i-b[0]-0.5)+abs(j-b[1]-0.5))
            di,dj=i-bi-0.5,j-bj-0.5
            if abs(di)!=1.5 or abs(dj)!=1.5: continue
            ni,nj=int(bi+0.5+dj),int(bj+0.5-di)
            si=1 if dj>0 else -1
            sj=1 if -di>0 else -1
            cells=[(ni,nj)]; k=1
            while True:
                a,b=ni+si*k,nj+sj*k
                if not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w) or (a,b) in shadows: break
                cells.append((a,b)); k+=1
            moves.append((v,cells))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for bi,bj in blocks:
        for a in (bi,bi+1):
            for b in (bj,bj+1): out[a][b]=2
    for v,cells in moves:
        for a,b in cells: out[a][b]=v
    return out

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    blocks=[(i,j) for i in range(h-1) for j in range(w-1)
            if g[i][j]==2 and g[i][j+1]==2 and g[i+1][j]==2 and g[i+1][j+1]==2]
    moves=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v in (0,2): continue
            cands=[]
            for bi,bj in blocks:
                di,dj=i-bi-0.5,j-bj-0.5
                if abs(di)==1.5 and abs(dj)==1.5:
                    cands.append((abs(di)+abs(dj),bi,bj,di,dj))
            if not cands: continue
            _,bi,bj,di,dj=min(cands)
            ni,nj=int(bi+0.5+dj),int(bj+0.5-di)
            si=1 if dj>0 else -1
            sj=1 if -di>0 else -1
            cells=[(ni,nj)]; k=1
            while True:
                a,b=ni+si*k,nj+sj*k
                if not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w): break
                # down-left rays halt before entering a cell whose left neighbor is a block cell
                if si==1 and sj==-1 and b>0 and g[a][b-1]==2: break
                cells.append((a,b)); k+=1

    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]

        for a in (bi,bi+1):
            for b in (bj,bj+1): out[a][b]=2
    for v,cells in moves:
        for a,b in cells: out[a][b]=v
    return out

def analyze(gi,go,label):
    gi=[r[:] for r in gi]; h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0])
    blocks=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if gi[i][j]==2]
    balls=[(gi[i][j],i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if gi[i][j] not in (0,2)]
    for c,i,j in balls:
        cands=[]
        for (bi,bj) in blocks:
            di,dj=i-bi-0.5,j-bj-0.5
            if abs(di)==1.5 and abs(dj)==1.5: cands.append((abs(di)+abs(dj),bi,bj,di,dj))
        if not cands: continue
        _,bi,bj,di,dj=min(cands)
        ni,nj=int(bi+0.5+dj),int(bj+0.5-di)
        si=1 if dj>0 else -1
        sj=1 if -di>0 else -1
        if (si,sj)==(1,-1):  # down-left ray
            # trace, note where output stops
            k=0; path=[]
            while True:
                a,b=ni+si*k,nj+sj*k
                if not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w): break
                path.append((a,b,go[a][b] if k>0 else None))
                k+=1
            print(label,'ball',c,(i,j),'rot',(ni,nj),'path/out:',[(a,b,v) for a,b,v in path])
for nm,(gi,go) in {'d1':(demo_in,demo_out),'d2':(in2,out2),'d3':(d3_in,d3_out),'d4':(d4_in,d4_out)}.items():

def transform4(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    blocks=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==2]
    balls=[(g[i][j],i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (0,2)]
    origs=[(i,j) for c,i,j in balls]
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for (i,j) in blocks: out[i][j]=2
    for c,i,j in balls:
        cands=[]
        for (bi,bj) in blocks:
            di,dj=i-bi-0.5,j-bj-0.5
            if abs(di)==1.5 and abs(dj)==1.5: cands.append((abs(di)+abs(dj),bi,bj,di,dj))
        if not cands: continue
        _,bi,bj,di,dj=min(cands)
        ni,nj=int(bi+0.5+dj),int(bj+0.5-di)
        si=1 if dj>0 else -1
        sj=1 if -di>0 else -1
        a,b=ni,nj
        while True:
            if not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w) or g[a][b]==2: break
            if (a,b)!=(ni,nj) and any(abs(a-oi)+abs(b-oj)==1 for oi,oj in origs if (oi,oj)!=(i,j)): break
            out[a][b]=c
            a,b=a+si,b+sj
    return out

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    blocks=[(i,j) for i in range(h-1) for j in range(w-1)
            if g[i][j]==2 and g[i][j+1]==2 and g[i+1][j]==2 and g[i+1][j+1]==2]
    moves=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v in (0,2): continue
            cands=[]
            for bi,bj in blocks:
                di,dj=i-bi-0.5,j-bj-0.5
                if abs(di)==1.5 and abs(dj)==1.5:
                    cands.append((abs(di)+abs(dj),bi,bj,di,dj))
            if not cands: continue
            _,bi,bj,di,dj=min(cands)
            ni,nj=int(bi+0.5+dj),int(bj+0.5-di)
            si=1 if dj>0 else -1
            sj=1 if -di>0 else -1
            cells=[(ni,nj)]; k=1
            while True:
                a,b=ni+si*k,nj+sj*k
                if not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w): break
                # rays halt before entering a block cell
                if g[a][b]==2: break
                # down-left rays halt before entering a cell whose RIGHT neighbor is a block cell
                if si==1 and sj==-1 and b+1<w and g[a][b+1]==2: break
                cells.append((a,b)); k+=1
            moves.append((v,cells))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for bi,bj in blocks:
        for a in (bi,bi+1):
            for b in (bj,bj+1): out[a][b]=2
    for v,cells in moves:
        for a,b in cells: out[a][b]=v
    return out
